evals.name: plan-then-apply
evals.prompt: Let's go through the review comments on my PR and fix them.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current-branch PR, gathers only the open review threads, presents a per-comment plan, waits for the user's sign-off BEFORE editing any code, then applies fixes, commits, pushes, and responds to each thread on GitHub.
assertions: Identifies the PR for the current branch (or from the provided reference) before doing anything else
Gathers review context via the shared helper / gh, capturing comment IDs for later replies
Presents a plan grouped by reviewer/file with a proposed action per comment
Waits for user sign-off on the plan before making any code changes
After approval: applies fixes, commits with standalone bullets, pushes, and responds to threads (resolve/reply/leave-open)

evals.name: ambiguous-comment-flagged
evals.prompt: Address the feedback on this PR — the reviewer left a mix of required changes and some optional suggestions.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes required changes (accept and apply) from optional suggestions (flag as 'needs user input' rather than silently applying), and does not resolve a suggestion thread on the user's behalf without their decision.
assertions: Classifies each comment's proposed action (accept-as-is / accept-with-interpretation / needs-user-input / disagree)
Optional or invitation-to-decide suggestions are flagged as 'needs user input' rather than applied automatically
Does not resolve or reply on a thread the user hasn't decided on
Presents options for the ambiguous items and asks the user before proceeding

evals.name: skip-resolved-second-round
evals.prompt: The reviewer left another round of comments on my PR — can you handle the new feedback?
evals.expected_output: Reflects the current review state: works only the open/unresolved threads and does not replay threads already resolved in a prior round. Treats silence on a nit as still-open, not resolved.
assertions: Fetches the current review state rather than assuming a prior run's results
Only works threads that are still open/unresolved; skips already-resolved threads
Does not re-apply or re-respond to comments handled in a previous round
Treats an unreplied nit/suggestion as still open rather than resolved
